name: Privacy, PII & Data Retention
description: Privacy, PII & Data Retention standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-PRIV applies.

rules.title: Collect only data required for an explicit purpose
rules.detail: Every personal-data field must have a documented purpose and owner; avoid speculative collection.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Collect only data required for an explicit purpose.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Collect only data required for an explicit purpose.

rules.title: Classify sensitive data and apply stronger controls
rules.detail: Identify PII, financial, health, identity and authentication data and apply appropriate encryption, masking, access and audit controls.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Classify sensitive data and apply stronger controls.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Classify sensitive data and apply stronger controls.

rules.title: Define retention and deletion behavior
rules.detail: For each personal-data class, specify retention period, legal/business basis, deletion/anonymization process and backup implications.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Define retention and deletion behavior.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Define retention and deletion behavior.

rules.title: Support applicable user privacy rights
rules.detail: Where required, provide traceable workflows for access, correction, export, consent withdrawal and deletion.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Support applicable user privacy rights.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Support applicable user privacy rights.

rules.title: Prevent sensitive data leakage through logs and analytics
rules.detail: Logs, telemetry, URLs, crash reports and analytics must redact or avoid personal and secret values by default.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Prevent sensitive data leakage through logs and analytics.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Prevent sensitive data leakage through logs and analytics.

rules.title: Review third-party data sharing
rules.detail: Document processors/recipients, fields shared, purpose, region and contractual/security requirements before integration.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Review third-party data sharing.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Review third-party data sharing.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-PRIV applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Privacy, PII & Data Retention to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Privacy, PII & Data Retention is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Privacy, PII & Data Retention failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
